title: 'I'd rather die than ring the police': Distrust and fear in Middlesbrough after A66 crash
description: BBC News visits town where violence has escalated after the fatal crash and residents say they are living in fear.

title: Cleveland police chief proud of force but being 'let down' by funding
description: Victoria Fuller tells the BBC Cleveland Police needs to become part of a larger, strategic force with greater resources.

title: How the Lindsay Clancy trial gripped America - and ultimately fell apart
description: A Massachusetts judge has declared a mistrial in the murder case against the US mother after jurors were unable to reach a unanimous verdict.

title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
description: The Togo-sponsored resolution was backed by 164 nations - with the US as the only nation to vote against it.

title: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
description: There are still hundreds of workers trapped in a network of tunnels that run along the Trishuli river.

title: Lauryn Hill, Wyclef and Giggs among surprise guests at Jay-Z's long-awaited UK show
description: The US rapper rolled back the years for more than two hours at the first of his two shows in London.

title: Flight price rises due to 'foolish leaders' starting wars, Virgin's Branson says
description: Middle East tensions have choked the production and transportation of oil, causing a surge in the price of car and jet fuels.

title: Cambridge launches review into support for Jason Arday before death
description: The University of Cambridge says the review will look at its "decision-making and actions" before the former professor's death.

title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
description: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.
